verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh lets users configure the risk-score equation and create multiple screening configurations. Screening and ongoing monitoring then automatically trigger alerting and emit WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhook events. However, the evidence shows no general user-defined rules engine that maps events to arbitrary automated actions. Webhooks are only notification building blocks, and case decisions appear to be manual. missing for 10: a documented event→condition→action rules/automation builder, user-configurable automated actions (e.g., auto-escalate, auto-assign, auto-decision), examples of rule-triggered workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration
